reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: candidates at 1-based manifest positions 51-60 (0-based 50-59) of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 22 arms; coordinator cross-check of FDA, MHRA, PMDA and JFDA original full texts
blinding: data/validation/self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs NOT opened. FRDB snapshot (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a verified) read for arm metadata with every 'cmax' column dropped before display; arms mapped by AUC / t1/2 / n / application comment only; no arm selected by outcome.
method_note: Single AI pass. Paywalls time-boxed (Unpaywall, PMC, direct publisher fetch); browser automation not used to avoid writing into the repo's .playwright-mcp. IR not inferred from oral route: conventional tablets/capsules/solutions without an MR claim = verified_with_caveat (prior-batch precedent); dosage form absent = unverified. Coordinator used the same nominal reported-dose convention as the prior mozavaptan adjudication; salt/hydrate equivalents remain documented. No model predictions or FRDB Cmax were opened.
unresolved_issues: Malotilate frdb_1520: abstract 500 mg vs FRDB 600 mg; full text needed.
Azeliragon frdb_7901 duplicates frdb_7899 (same healthy reference group); collapse if ever scored; poster lacks dosage form.
Oxatomide: values from IF rev.10 (2026-06), not the cited revision 071 (404).
Mirodenafil frdb_8244: 100 ug microdose, formulation unknown.
Paywalled originals needing library retrieval: Buhrer 1986 EJCP (malotilate), Lan 2006 RCM (tranilast), Wang 2007 JPBA (limonene), Kobari 1984 EJCP (aprindine), Cho 2013 J Sep Sci (mirodenafil).
Process note: one Unpaywall API query carried the user's contact email as the required email parameter.
Tranilast frdb_4337 excluded: the accessible original full text shows one pooled FRDB row across two capsule products; neither component arm was in the frozen manifest.

arms.reason: Open-access MHRA PAR. Single-dose fasted crossover BE study in healthy adult males, plasma diethylstilbestrol; FRDB AUC 9741.84 matches the Test column, so arm = Kinedexe test 1 mg film-coated tablet. Caveats: statistic is geometric least-squares mean; n not reported; IR not stated in words, but product is a conventional film-coated tablet with no modified-release designation.
arms.exact_locator: PAR PL 44710/0016, section IV.2, p.8 (design) and p.9 Results table (image)
arms.fasting_evidence: 'single-dose ... in healthy, adult, male, human subjects under fasting conditions' (p.8)
arms.formulation_evidence: Diethylstilbestrol 1 mg film-coated tablets (Kinedexe test); reference Teva 1 mg tablets
arms.dose_evidence: 1 mg single oral dose with 240 mL water
arms.population: healthy adult males (n not reported in PAR)

arms.reason: Original Table 1 shows the FRDB n=24, AUCinf 422, Cmax 42.2 as a pooled statistic over the same 12 subjects receiving two different capsule products (Rizaben and Tranpro). arms.reason: FDA original review Table 7 confirms parent lactitol plasma Cmax after a single fasted oral dose in 16 healthy adults. The 21 g lactitol monohydrate powder was dissolved in water (immediate oral solution), and the frozen manifest uses the same reported nominal 21 g dose. This is equivalent to 20 g anhydrous lactitol; retain that basis in the record. High SD is an observation-uncertainty issue, not an eligibility failure.
arms.exact_locator: Review PDF p.49, Table 7 (Study BLI400-101), Fasted row; text PDF p.47
arms.fasting_evidence: 'subjects had over-night fast, received lactitol and continued to fast for 6 hours'
arms.formulation_evidence: powder dissolved in 8 oz water (oral solution)
arms.population: healthy subjects, n=16
arms.dose_basis_note: 21 g monohydrate nominal dose = 20 g anhydrous lactitol; frozen prediction used 21 g nominal

candidates.name: NALFURAFINE
candidates.candidate_notes: Cited IF 404; PMDA review report (A100_2) and CTD 2.7.6 (K100_1) open and used. Coordinator checked the PMDA English review pp.39-41,49: the exact Ph-1 capsule formulation released contents fully in 3.2-4.6 minutes; the 30 μg oral solution is intrinsically immediate release. All 5 arms use reported nominal HCl doses, consistent with the prior P0 mozavaptan convention.

arms.reason: Cited IF URL is 404; second cited source (CTD 2.7.6) used. Food-effect study 820P1C02: 10 ug soft capsule (Ph-1 formulation, PEG400/water solution fill, release within minutes per A100_2 p.29), fasted arm, 12 healthy Japanese adult males, plasma TRK-820; AUC0-48 114.46 and t1/2 5.99 match FRDB. Original PMDA review identifies the exact study formulation. Ph-1 capsules release their contents fully within 3.2-4.6 minutes; the 30 μg study used an oral solution. Dose is the reported nominal hydrochloride mass, retained in the frozen prediction, as in the prior mozavaptan adjudication.
